verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers hybrid search, RRF fusion of full-text and vector rankings, and a generic mention of reranking. None of it documents custom ranking rules or boosting by business signals such as popularity, recency or margin. RRF and vector similarity are adjacent relevance features, not business-signal ranking, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can shape relevance with custom ranking rules and business signals (popularity, recency, margin) beyond textual matching
